Xiao Li says, "I especially like listening to Chinese songs."
After class, they go to eat lunch together.
They speak Chinese while eating.
Xiao Li says, "I want to write five characters every day."
His classmate says, "OK, let's study together."
The teacher sees them in the classroom and smiles too.
That day, Xiao Li has a happy time.
